svg.aria-label: AWS architecture of the University Results Portal
svg.text: Terraform-managed WordPress portal in us-east-1. Planned resources have faded icons, orange labels and dashed outlines.
reached from EC2 through the NAT Gateway
HTTP :80 listener, nodes in both AZs
Launch Template across AZ A and B

Security groups: Internet → ALB :80 · ALB → EC2 :80 · EC2 → RDS :3306. Private DB subnets have no internet route. HTTPS (ACM), shared uploads and a second NAT Gateway are separate future improvements.
